Synopsis:
This random Fist is standing by the door to Flaming Fist HQ. As opposed to the shame spot at the gate this is an honor spot basically employee of the moth reward. He has some reactions to execution of Florrick. Turns out he's extremely lawful.. and awful.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BasiliskGate_DoorGuard.json: A Flaming Fist soldier stands posted at the honored doorway of Flaming Fist HQ, proud of his assignment and eager to declaim official justice. A public execution of someone called Florrick has just occurred in the square; the Fist loudly brands her a traitor and voices relish at her fate, reflecting a rigid, law‑obsessed cruelty. The player’s replies in the scene can range from defending Florrick to approving the sentence or scolding the guard for his callousness. If the nearby windmill/pixie disturbance is active, that commotion has already drawn local goblins off to investigate, leaving this guard as the main on‑screen interlocutor.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_ExecutionGuard_02.json: This guards gets spawned along with Counselor Florrick's executed body to keep an eye on it. Clearly didn't approve of the execution.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_Executioner.json: A Flaming Fist soldier (Fist "Edge" Arensen) is posted on the gallows in the Lower City, loudly threatening that cultists, thieves and other troublemakers will be hanged — he’s stern, brutal, and enforcing order. Off‑screen, the player has just tampered with a nearby windmill, which flung a small gnome and drew a pack of goblins (led by Fezzerk and scouts) away to investigate, so the city is already on edge. In some variations the player is also carrying the Moonlantern/pixie, weighing whether to keep its protection or free it; either way, the player’s replies range from defiant taunts to placating compliance. Edge’s line functions as a generic Flaming Fist warning used by patrolling guards around the Audience Hall and Lower City.
- WYR_WyrmRock_AudienceHallGuard_001.json: You’re overhearing a Flaming Fist patrolman on duty in the Audience Hall — a short, formal exchange meant to enforce order and reassure visitors. Off‑screen the city is tense from recent trouble at the Steel Watch Foundry: the Neurocitor control centre links and drives the Watchers and has been the focus of sabotage, rescues and factional manoeuvring, so soldiers are on edge. The guard’s clipped lines (“No distractions,” “I must be vigilant,” “Hail the Archduke!”) reflect strict Flaming Fist discipline, loyalty to the Archduke, and anxiety about Watcher-related threats. These are single‑line patrol utterances; depending on prior player action in the Foundry crisis you may encounter different reactions or follow‑ups.
- WYR_WyrmRock_AudienceHallGuard_002.json: You’re in the Audience Hall speaking with a patrolling Flaming Fist guard shortly after major events around the Steel Watch Foundry. Off‑screen the Foundry’s lowest floor houses the Neurocitor, a Gondian–illithid neural switchboard that links and drives the Steel Watchers; the player has recently been drawn into that crisis (asked by Gondian leader Zanner Toobin to deal with the Control Centre) and may have interacted with or disrupted it, which would explain the guard’s line about the Watchers being disabled. The city is tense: factions (Iron Throne remnants, Zhentarim, guilds) and recent rescues or near‑explosions (Volo, a trapped child, etc.) have raised stakes, and news that “Lord Gortash is dead” would be a public claim tied to those upheavals. The guard’s proud, dutiful tone reflects Flaming Fist loyalty and the official line that they fulfilled their obligations amid the chaos.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Fist Miller: Take heed, citizen - the traitor Florrick swings in the square. She won't be missed. (node 10)
- Player: She didn't deserve to die. (node 2)

Sample 2:
- Fist Miller: Take heed, citizen - the traitor Florrick swings in the square. She won't be missed. (node 10)
- Player: Good riddance. (node 11)

Sample 3:
- Fist Miller: Take heed, citizen - the traitor Florrick swings in the square. She won't be missed. (node 10)
- Player: That's a cruel way to talk about her. (node 8)

context: You’re facing a Flaming Fist soldier posted at the honored doorway of Flaming Fist HQ — an “honor spot” rather than the public shame post at the gate. A public execution of Counselor Florrick has just taken place in the square, and the guard loudly brands her a traitor and revels in the sentence, speaking from a rigid, law‑obsessed viewpoint. The player’s replies can range from defending Florrick to approving the sentence or scolding the guard for his callousness. In some variations the guard is specifically posted with Florrick’s body or reacts slightly differently, and if a nearby windmill/pixie disturbance drew local goblins away, this soldier will be the primary on‑screen interlocutor.
